title: Semester Registration and Examination Fee Notification
description: Students of III Year I Semester must pay the examination fee for the Dec 2026 semester end examinations before the last date. Late fee applies after the due date.

title: Two Day Workshop on VLSI Design
description: ECE department is conducting a two day workshop on VLSI Design. Interested students can register with the department office.

title: Industrial Visit for III Year CSE
description: An industrial visit is planned on 12 Nov 2026 for III Year CSE students. Submit the parent consent letter to the class coordinator by 05 Nov 2026.

title: Technical Seminar Registration
description: CSE students can register for the technical seminar. Meet your class coordinator for the topic list and the schedule.

title: Last Date for College Fee Payment
description: The last date to pay the college fee for the year 2026-27 is 30 Oct 2026. A fine of Rs. 500 per week applies after the last date.

title: Dress Code and ID Card
description: Wearing the college ID card is compulsory inside the campus. Students without ID cards will not be allowed inside.

title: Mid-I Examination Schedule
description: Mid-I examinations for all III Year students will be held from 21 Sep to 26 Sep 2026. Hall tickets are not required for Mid examinations.

title: Commencement of III Year I Semester
description: Classes for III Year I Semester begin on 03 Aug 2026. All students must attend with ID cards.
